keyword: who puts the green jacket on a back to back winner
claims: When a player wins the Masters in consecutive years, the Augusta National Golf Club Chairman puts the green jacket on them rather than the previous year's winner.
Typically, the reigning Masters champion helps the new winner slip on the green jacket.
Chairman Fred Ridley presented the green jacket to Rory McIlroy in 2026.
Chairman Hootie Johnson presented the green jacket to Tiger Woods in 2002.
Chairman Hord Hardin presented the green jacket to Nick Faldo in 1990.
Jack Nicklaus put the green jacket on himself in 1966.
Jack Nicklaus became the first back-to-back winner of the Masters in 1966
